# Embedded OpenDyslexic fonts

Source repository: https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic

Unmodified WOFF2 files are embedded as base64 data URLs in `styles.css`.
The following Git blob hashes pin the exact font binaries:
- `compiled/OpenDyslexic-Regular.woff2`: `4ee220be7e9b551ad100468bd08ba35f6f9fe2f8` (https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic/blob/main/compiled/OpenDyslexic-Regular.woff2)
- `compiled/OpenDyslexic-Bold.woff2`: `b5fd5e4f4b0977495d39bb3220096aef50120e31` (https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic/blob/main/compiled/OpenDyslexic-Bold.woff2)
- `OFL.txt`: `bb867823f2408fb8d2b3af5cb118b4bc0cd61972` (https://github.com/antijingoist/opendyslexic/blob/main/OFL.txt)
